feeds.title: WOWK 13 News
feeds.description: Check out the WOWK 13 News website for trending Charleston-Huntington news & weather stories, as well as concise reporting covering local sports, community, education, and more topics. WOWK is the CBS affiliate for Charleston-Huntington, WV Channel 13 provides coverage of news, weather, and sports for the southwestern part of the state.
